content: The apex of the heart represents the most inferior and superficial portion of the heart. It is oriented in a downward, forward, and leftward direction. This region is anatomically overlapped by the left lung and its associated pleura. In terms of external anatomy, the apex is positioned posterior to the fifth left intercostal space, approximately 8 to 9 centimeters lateral to the mid-sternal line. It is located slightly medial to the midclavicular line. Alternatively, its position can be described as being about 4 centimeters inferior and 2 millimeters medial to the left mammary papilla.
